scope: Prereview fixture proposal, not yet run; no original W formula or outcome evaluated. The 25 synthetic inputs have original hand-specified denotational expectations and native/AST transfer controls remain a separate layer.

fixtures.source:
(set-logic ALL)
(set-option :produce-models true)
(echo "T01-equality-pair")
(declare-const x Int)
(assert (= x x))
(assert (not (= x x)))
(check-sat)
(exit)
fixtures.reason: Reflexivity is independent of the unbounded integer.

fixtures.source:
(set-logic ALL)
(set-option :produce-models true)
(echo "T02-swapped-assertions")
(declare-const x Int)
(assert (not (= x x)))
(assert (= x x))
(check-sat)
(exit)
fixtures.reason: Same unsatisfiability as T01; exposes loss of assertion order.

fixtures.source:
(set-logic ALL)
(set-option :produce-models true)
(echo "T03-arbitrary-negative-model")
(declare-const x Int)
(assert (< x (- 10000000000000000000000)))
(assert (<= x x))
(check-sat)
(exit)
fixtures.reason: The displayed negative integer is a satisfying value. No machine integer bound is allowed.

fixtures.source:

(assert (distinct (_ bv0 3) (_ bv1 3) (_ bv0 3)))
(check-sat)
(exit)
fixtures.reason: First and third three-bit values coincide.

fixtures.source:
(set-logic ALL)
(set-option :produce-models true)
(echo "T06-zero-extended-sub")
(assert (= ((_ zero_extend 4) (bvsub (_ bv0 3) (_ bv1 3))) (_ bv7 7)))
(assert (not (= (bvshl (_ bv1 7) (_ bv7 7)) (_ bv0 7))))
(check-sat)
(exit)
fixtures.reason: Three-bit subtraction wraps to seven. A seven-bit word shifted by seven is zero.

fixtures.source:
(set-logic ALL)
(set-option :produce-models true)
(echo "T07-extract-and-or")
(assert (= ((_ extract 3 1) (_ bv10 4)) (_ bv5 3)))
(assert (= (bvor (bvand (_ bv5 3) (_ bv3 3)) (_ bv2 3)) (_ bv3 3)))
(check-sat)
(exit)
fixtures.reason: Binary 1010 extracts 101; (101 AND 011) OR 010 is 011.

fixtures.source:
(set-logic ALL)
(set-option :produce-models true)
(echo "T08-param-scope")
(declare-const x Int)
(declare-const q Bool)
(define-fun xplus () Int (+ x 1))
(define-fun choose ((q Bool) (x Int) (y Int)) Int (ite q x y))
(define-fun g ((x Int) (q Bool)) Int (choose q x xplus))
(assert (= (g 8 true) 8))
(assert (= (g 11 false) (+ x 1)))
(check-sat)
(exit)
fixtures.reason: Scoped local formals shadow the global x and q; xplus retains its free global x.

fixtures.source:
(set-logic ALL)
(set-option :produce-models true)
(echo "T09-unused-int")
(declare-const w Int)
(define-fun dead () Bool (> w 999999999999))
(assert true)
(assert false)
(check-sat)
(exit)
fixtures.reason: The unused declared integer remains unrestricted.

fixtures.source:
(set-logic ALL)
(set-option :produce-models true)
(echo "T10-comments-whitespace")
; (assert false) in a comment has no semantics
(assert	(=> true true)) ; trailing comment including )
(assert (= (ite false 7 4) 4))
(check-sat)
(exit)
fixtures.reason: Tabs and comments do not create terms or close lists.

fixtures.source:
(set-logic ALL)
(set-option :produce-models true)
(echo "T11-indicator-sum")
(define-fun pred ((f (_ BitVec 2))) Bool (= (bvand f (_ bv1 2)) (_ bv1 2)))
(assert (= (+ (ite (pred (_ bv0 2)) 1 0) (ite (pred (_ bv1 2)) 1 0)) 1))
(assert (distinct (_ bv0 2) (_ bv1 2)))
(check-sat)
(exit)
fixtures.reason: The masks zero and one contribute zero and one; two supplied literals differ.

fixtures.source:

(set-option :produce-models true)

(assert f)
(assert g)
(check-sat)
(exit)
fixtures.expected: typed/shape rejection with no successful assertion result
fixtures.reason: The earlier definition references a future symbol.
